cd fs && python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,time,os,signal
cmd=['qemu-system-riscv64','-machine','virt','-bios','none','-kernel','kernel/kernel','-m','128M','-smp','1','-nographic','-global','virtio-mmio.force-legacy=false','-drive','file=fs.img,if=none,format=raw,id=x0','-device','virtio-blk-device,drive=x0,bus=virtio-mmio-bus.0']
p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
buf=b''
def drain(t):
    global buf
    end=time.time()+t
    while time.time()<end:
        try:
            p.stdout.settimeout(0.5)
            d=p.stdout.read(4096)
            if d: buf+=d
        except Exception: pass
        if b'$ ' in buf: return
drain(20)
p.stdin.write(b'bigfile\n'); p.stdin.flush()
drain(120)
p.kill()
try: buf+=p.stdout.read()
except Exception: pass
print('=== captured ===')
print(buf.decode('utf-8','replace'))
PY
